pages.title: The Moon
pages.text: A cold and desolate landscape, who in their right mind would want to go there? Oh that right, you would. Well in that case, you should get yourself a method of propulsion. A $(item)Elytra$() with a bunch of $(item)Fireworks$() should do the trick. Try to get up to 1000 Blocks in the air in the $(thing)Overworld$(), this should suffice in reaching the $(thing)Moon$().
The $(item)Oxygen Collector$() can $(thing)collect oxygen$() and $(thing)fuel$() various $(item)items$().
